origin: New bounded candidate from the September 12 reporting reconciliation.

repairs.finding: The reported 38-gigawatt roadmap could be mistaken for present energy consumption or a company-confirmed all-AI plan.
repairs.repair: Led with the reported roadmap, defined gigawatts as power at a moment, separated capacity from energy over time, stated the AI-specific shares and bound the Bloomberg public excerpt without claiming full access.
repairs.remaining: Distinct independent semantic review remains required; no provider call was made.
